sentences.text: This is the fifth application filed by the applicant under Section 439 of the CrPC for grant of regular bail relating to Crime No.867 of 2021 registered at Police Station Kotwali District Rewa (M.P.) for the offences under Sections 498A, 304B & 34 of the IPC and 3/4 of the Dowry Prohibition Act.

He is in judicial custody since 17.02.2022.
2.

This time the bail is pleaded on the ground that the statement of constable Ramkhilawan (PW9)
who has taken the photographs of the crime scene has been recorded before the trial Court.
It is argued that the seizure of suicide note becomes doubtful because none of the photographs were taken by the present witness.
However, he fairly submits that the matter has already been considered thrice on merits and the same was rejected.
The matter travelled upto the Hon'ble Supreme Court and vide order dated 06.04.2023 passed in Special Leave to Appeal (Crl.) No.3965 of 2023, the SLP was dismissed.
